name: The Balcony Solar Bill Gov. Sherrill Just Signed is a Win
summary: Substack post breaking down New Jersey's balcony solar bill and what it changes for renters, condo owners and ratepayers.
description: Post in Brian Varela's Inside the Garden State newsletter, dated Sep 12, 2026: after New Jersey electric bills rose 17.23-20.20% (the Board of Public Utilities blamed PJM capacity auction results), the balcony solar bill offers renters and condo owners a way to cut bills. It also covers what landlords and HOAs can still require.
